1243066.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
1243066.reason: Transitive via expo > @expo/cli > zod@3.25.76. No zod 3.x patch exists and the latest @expo/cli (58.1.17) still pins zod@^3.25.76. The app's own zod dependency is already the patched 4.6.7. The DoS only affects the local build/dev CLI, not the shipped app.

1243505.title: deepmerge mergeObject() allows prototype poisoning of returned objects
1243505.reason: Transitive via expo (@expo/config) and jest (jest-config). No patch available upstream. Low severity, build/test tooling only.
